title: spring.casbin
description: Two buckets: spring.casbin.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.casbin.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.casbin.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

policy.description: Path to the policy file (policy.csv); mutually exclusive with Adapter

autoSave.description: Whether policy mutations are persisted back to the storage
